Title: Retirement: Extended support for PHP 8.2 ends December 31st, 2026 – upgrade apps to PHP 8.3

Body.Content:
On December 31st, 2026, extended support for PHP 8.2 will end. Your apps that are hosted on App Service will continue to run, but security updates will no longer be available, and we’ll no longer provide customer service for PHP 8.2. 

Learn more.
